title: Full Body + French Contrast
warmup: 2 rounds: 1:00 bike · 10 goblet squats · 10 walking lunges · 10 band pull-aparts
jumps: Goblet squat 3 → Box jump 5 → DB squat jump 5 → Fast pogos 10
Goblet heavy @ RPE 8 · light DBs on the jump · max intent · rest 3:00

cond.subtitle: 5 rounds · new station every minute
cond.scaling: Cut reps so you get 15+ sec of rest each minute

note: Heavy first, then fast. Take the full 3:00 between contrast rounds.
